turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
You gave my son a zero. I'm here to find out why.
I haven't made any yet. Who decided on the zero, and when?
With respect, this is exactly what lawyers do. Make noise until the facts go away.
Then show me the facts, Hale. I asked who decided and when, and I'm still waiting.
Your son cheated, and you're teaching him that Mom can make it disappear.
Owen doesn't lie, and you've just called me a liar too. Say it again without a document and this goes to the principal today.
